title: MTA Fare Evasion Data For Bus Routes

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

An electronic copy of an existing database extract or summary record(s) maintained by the Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) to show:

The monthly individual route level bus fare evasion rate for each bus route, including Local/Limited, Select Bus Service (SBS), and Express routes, from January 2023 through January 2025.

Please include only the basic identifying fields maintained alongside the rate in that table (such as the route name/number, month or quarter, borough, and service type). I am not requesting working drafts, emails, or underlying raw sensor/transaction logs.

Format:

Please provide this record electronically in a machine-readable tabular format regularly maintained by the agency (such as .csv or .xlsx). Because the MTA computes route-level fare evasion rates prior to aggregating them into published borough and systemwide totals, this request seeks only the extraction of existing electronic data and does not ask the agency to create a new record.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Mantie N REID II
